current_blockers.policy: Presence and readback do not equal binary verification. Keep Verified false until each immutable artifact hash is computed and stored.

current_blockers.description: The exact 0x4A30 physical save layout and integrity ABI are confirmed, but most header fields, summary fields +0x0C/+0x10/+0x14, semantic segmentation of the 0x708 payload, trailer states beyond 0/1 and the exact production writer remain unresolved.
current_blockers.policy: Use controlled differential saves and runtime traces. Do not introduce semantic editor labels or writes before evidence closes each field or region.

resolved_corrections.description: The unresolved historical receipt and nonexistent declared paths were replaced by reviewed PR 31 outputs that exist in the active repository and passed Windows and Ubuntu CI, 58 of 58 tests on each platform.

Late Pass Control and Artifact Checklist rows were normalized to their declared columns. Artifact presence is now separated from SHA-256 verification, and the correction is recorded in Sync Log and Decisions & Corrections.

The Passes sheet gained explicit Date, Recovered Source, Drive Sync, Git Receipt and Repository Paths columns; Pass 29-31 rows were normalized. The Artifacts and Overview tabs now record actual reviewed repository outputs and authority roles.

The confirmed Pass 31 PC save physical layout, 21-block integrity ABI, packed-BCD summary fields and conservative open-semantic boundary were migrated into reviewed C++, tests and machine-readable evidence. This does not imply bulk promotion of the remaining recovered source tree.
